Ethan Winters
ethan.winters@example.com | Louisville, KY
Ethan Winters has 8 years of experience in data. Most recently, Senior Data
Engineer at Windmere Labs (2024-2026), where they wrote Python and Spark batch
jobs to process large-scale event data. Before that, Data Engineer at Beacon
Platform (2022-2024). Before that, Data Engineer I at Cobalt Software
(2018-2022). Education: B.S. Software Engineering, SMU, 2018. Core skills:
PostgreSQL, ETL pipelines, Distributed systems, AWS, Distributed systems,
Kafka, dbt, TypeScript.
